Only 22% of remote job listings disclose pay. The two brand-design gigs that do show $1,500-$5,000 per project.

We pulled the numbers from 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar. Here is what brand designers see in 2026:

Stevens - Brand Identity Designer (B2B SaaS logistics), $3,000-$5,000 per fixed project.
Sidekicks Creative Studio - Brand Identity Designer (street food), $1,500-$3,000 per fixed project.
WTP Global - Basic Corporate Video Edits, $800-$1,200 per fixed project.
Love Isn't Blind - Social Media Video Editor & Growth Associate, $1,000-$2,000 per month.
South Digital - Operations & Delivery Lead, $2,000-$4,000 per month.

853 listings disclose pay (22%); 3,087 do not (78%). 64% are open to worldwide remote applicants.

Contrarian take: the top $3,000-$5,000 fixed contract means short, high-pressure sprints. A $1,500-$3,000 retainer can give steadier cash flow and room to upsell. Judge the scope, timeline, and revision policy before assuming higher lump sum equals higher net income.

Both brand-design roles are live as of 2026-10-12 and accept applicants from any country.

Full breakdown:
https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
